name: Aliya
source:
Possessing a strong sense of justice and desire to protect the weak, Aliya is a devoted warrior, hard-working and determined. Due to her impulsive nature, she often jumps headfirst into battle without considering the consequences, so it isn't unusual to see her sporting wounds all over and having to repair her armor yet again. Despite her bubbly and cheerful personality, Aliya has many anxiety issues and negative feelings that she has yet to deal with and just suppresses and covers up with a smile.

[From [url=https://ebullience-games.itch.io/airis]itch.io[/url]]
